scope: All 99 AttackCatalog entries plus a source-reviewed non-Arsenal action appendix. No recipe execution or live network/media tests.

status_definitions.needs-validation: Recipe exists; no end-to-end compatibility claim. Concrete verification work remains.
status_definitions.known-defect: Source contains an observable mismatch or failure path; needs correction before supported status.
status_definitions.incomplete: Required inputs, evidence, or workflow are absent.
status_definitions.sample-only: Prints instructions/examples instead of performing the advertised operation.
status_definitions.scope-blocked: Operation is not constrained to the selected authorized scope; keep unavailable pending redesign.
status_definitions.limited-confirmation: Narrow historical live report; broader compatibility is unverified.

shared_gaps.description: Authorization is a session checkbox, not a per-run allowlist. RF-range confirmation is a UI gate and is not enforced inside runSelected(). Network-wide commands can ignore the selected target. Scope-blocked entries should remain unavailable pending explicit scope review.

Attack.expanded substitutes names/SSIDs directly into shell strings. General recipes need typed/quoted arguments and fail-closed missing-input validation. The selected-file MediaAudioCommand path already quotes its arguments and has injection fixtures.

Auto routing compares only the first three IPv4 octets, rather than actual routes/netmasks; it does not prove remote reachability. Multicast/Bluetooth/RF tools often inspect the executor network, not the chosen LAN device.

Auto-install checks one declared executable/package only. Secondary binaries, wordlists, scripts, driver capabilities, noninteractive sudo, package availability and version compatibility are generally not preflighted. A nil package does not mean installed.

Most commands pipe into head/tail without pipefail. The final shell exit can be zero after the tool fails. The UI treats exit zero as success; generic recipes have no capability/finding outcome schema.

LocalClient terminates the shell and KaliClient terminates ssh; this does not prove child or remote jobs stopped. Shared temporary files and broad pkill lack per-run ownership. cancelled status/old-run events need explicit lifecycle handling.

The three selected-file actions share a quoted bundled audio runner with scoped HTTP serving, SOAP parsing and delivery checks. This is stronger than old URL templates, but audio metadata and a fixed run limit do not establish arbitrary file/video compatibility. The UI has an implicit Downloads clip fallback when no file is selected; remove the fallback and require an explicit readable file.

KaliRangeProbe creates/deletes monitor interfaces and runs a scan; it is not a pure read. It hardcodes interface patterns, mixes interactive sudo with a batch SSH transport, and does not make scan/cleanup failure a reliable capability result.

No recipe was dispatched during this audit. Except the narrow historical SMART/DLNA report, end-to-end target success is unverified. Dependency metadata, danger labels and explanatory prose are claims to review, not compatibility evidence.

other_app_actions.remaining_work: Implemented IPv4 peer targeting; complete Internet denial across IPv6, isolation and protected peers is not established. Stop currently announces idle before cleanup completes; restoration failures may be suppressed by generation checks.
MAC-based allowlists and JSON profile persistence exist. Validate persistence failures, duplicate SSIDs, network identity changes and randomized MAC behavior; metadata is not identity proof.

other_app_actions.action: Continuous device discovery / identity / Lobby / Recon
other_app_actions.remaining_work: Discovery/enrichment exists. Missed peers remain retained without reliable departure/return state; not all observations imply current reachability. Unknown devices must remain unknown. Coverage and UI consistency need fixtures and bounded expiry.

Throughput counts observable frames, not all LAN traffic or accurate per-device Internet upload/download. Speed-test failures collapse to zero and HTTP status is not validated. TCP-connect failures are not ICMP packet loss.

other_app_actions.action: Nearby Wi-Fi scan / Join / Disconnect / hidden network
other_app_actions.remaining_work: Actions exist; OS permissions, unavailable scan context, confirmed post-join network identity and error reporting need acceptance coverage. Do not infer empty results prove AP isolation.

Keychain/password actions and candidate suggestions exist. Vendor/default candidates are hypotheses, not recovered passwords. Verify secure handling and actual join outcome; RF recovery handoffs inherit unfinished catalog work.

UI persists days/hours/enabled state. No schedule execution consumer was found in AppCoordinator/helper; automatic enforcement is unfinished. Time zones, overnight ranges, sleep/wake and explicit scope gates remain undecided.

other_app_actions.action: Helper install / connect / reinstall / ping / quit
other_app_actions.remaining_work: Authenticated helper path and exact personal-build signature pin exist. No app/helper protocol version negotiation; reinstall/upgrade/rollback and reconnection snapshots need release tests. Admin approval is expected; Connected alone does not establish engine health.

New-device notifications exist; departure/return history is incomplete. Validate permission denial, deduplication, menu-bar/app state agreement and small-window accessibility without triggering real actions.

Bandwidth-hog toggle/threshold are stored, but no enforcement consumer was found. Stealth sampling exists in ARPSpoofer; its end-to-end behavior with the active responder and accurate traffic measurements needs verification. Do not describe either as confirmed QoS.
